Registered 501(c)(3) nonprofit 'East Bay Consortium of Educational Institutions' in Oakland, CA (ProPublica Nonprofit Explorer)

Its website lists college advising at Oakland high schools such as Castlemont, Fremont, Life Academy, McClymonds and MetWest, consistent with a data sharing agreement with OUSD's high school Linked Learning office
research.notes: The name 'East Bay Solano County Consortium' does not appear on the organization's own website; the equivalence rests on the UC Berkeley CEP page and Cal-SOAP listings (the project is known as the East Bay and Solano County Cal-SOAP). No main phone number is published on the site; EIN left null because the ProPublica page was not cited.

profile.legalName: The East Bay Consortium of Educational Institutions, Inc.
profile.summary: A nonprofit based in Oakland, California, that is one of the California Student Opportunity and Access Projects (Cal-SOAP) administered by the California Student Aid Commission. It provides college advising, academic enrichment, tutoring, mentoring and financial aid workshops to help East Bay students finish high school and enroll in college.

sources.title: CEP Programs - East Bay Consortium of Educational Institutions, Inc.

review.notes: The CEP page lists East Bay Solano County Consortium (EBSCC) linking to eastbayconsortium.org, and search results confirm EBSCC is the East Bay and Solano County Cal-SOAP run by The East Bay Consortium of Educational Institutions, Inc. in Oakland; legal name, Cal-SOAP status, services, PO Box and info@ email are all shown on the About and Contact pages, and the summary is neutral.
